nodes.description: Robot-specific perception, cognition, planning, interaction, and inference functions that convert observations and instructions into executable behavior.
Robot-adapted models that fuse vision, audio, touch, proprioception, and other observations; general multimodal foundation models remain owned by the primary AI chain.
Robot-adapted vision-language-action models that map multimodal observations and instructions to executable action representations; general foundation models remain owned by the primary AI chain.
Embodied models and software that decompose operator goals into robot-feasible tasks, constraints, and action plans.
Robot-adapted memory and environment models that maintain object, spatial, task, and interaction state across operations.
Robot decision software that selects actions, detects execution exceptions, and invokes recovery or escalation policies.
Robot-adapted models for speech, gesture, intent, and social interaction without claiming ownership of general conversational AI.
Deployment architecture that partitions robot inference between onboard compute and remote services under latency, safety, and connectivity constraints.
Motion planning and control functions that translate robot tasks into stable, coordinated, real-time body movement.
Control software that coordinates floating-base posture, contacts, limbs, and center-of-mass motion across the complete humanoid body.
Locomotion control software for step timing, foot placement, support transitions, and disturbance recovery in biped walking.
Collision-aware trajectory planning for coordinated shoulder, elbow, wrist, and end-effector movement.
Control software for coordinated finger position, force, contact, and manipulation sequences.
Control methods that regulate force along constrained directions while tracking position along complementary directions.
Receding-horizon robot control that optimizes motion subject to dynamics, contact, actuator, and safety constraints.
Robot motion policies trained through reinforcement learning for locomotion, manipulation, or recovery behaviors.
Deterministic software runtime that executes synchronized joint control loops, safety checks, and command updates.
Systems and assets for collecting robot experience, preparing embodied datasets, simulating behavior, and evaluating trained policies.
Systems that capture human or operator demonstrations and map them into robot-compatible motion and action records.
Curated robot observation, action, contact, language, and outcome records used to train embodied models and policies.

nodes.node_name: Robot Data Cleaning, Labeling, and Replay
nodes.description: Tooling that validates, annotates, segments, indexes, and replays robot trajectories and interaction data.
Physics-based software for testing robot mechanisms, sensors, controls, tasks, and environments before physical execution.
Parameterized virtual representations of specific humanoid platforms used for engineering analysis, calibration, and operational monitoring.
Simulated observations, trajectories, contacts, and labels generated to augment physical robot training data.
Methods that transfer policies and models from simulation to physical robots through randomization, adaptation, and calibration.
Integrated tools for embodied model training, experiment tracking, benchmark execution, regression analysis, and release qualification.

Humanoid-specific sensing requirements, qualification, packaging, calibration, selection, module integration, and system use across environment, body-state, contact, force, motion, and command sensing; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.
Integrated visible-light camera modules configured for humanoid perception, synchronization, calibration, and onboard data transport.

Humanoid-specific selection, packaging, calibration, synchronization, and integration requirements for eligible depth-sensing devices used in obstacle detection, manipulation, mapping, and interaction; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid-specific selection, packaging, calibration, synchronization, and integration requirements for eligible LiDAR devices used in localization, mapping, obstacle detection, and safety monitoring; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid-specific selection, packaging, calibration, synchronization, and qualification requirements for eligible IMUs used in body-state estimation; standalone IMU devices, sensor components, and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid joint-position and velocity sensing requirements covering eligible encoder selection, calibration, interfaces, and control compatibility; integrated packaging is represented by joint_encoder_module, while standalone encoder devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid joint-output torque sensing requirements covering qualification, calibration, packaging, interfaces, and integration for compliant control, load monitoring, and collision response; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid interface sensing requirements covering qualification, calibration, packaging, and integration of eligible six-axis force-torque devices at wrists, ankles, and other load paths; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.

Humanoid surface-sensing requirements covering eligible tactile-device selection, packaging, calibration, layout, and integration for touch, pressure, shear, slip, and texture detection; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.
Integrated multi-microphone modules for sound localization, speech capture, and acoustic event detection on robots.

Humanoid-specific selection and integration requirements for residual operating-state sensing such as limits, temperature, current, and discrete health signals; excludes every separately enumerated sensor node, while standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.
Onboard compute, controllers, electronics, and deterministic communication hardware integrated for humanoid robot execution.
Processors selected and configured for onboard robot AI workloads; the generic chip categories remain owned by semiconductor chains.
Integrated boards or modules combining selected processors, memory, power, interfaces, and thermal design for robot AI workloads.
Central robot control units that coordinate perception, planning, motion commands, diagnostics, and system state.
Dedicated control units that calculate and distribute synchronized actuator commands for robot joints.
Microcontroller components selected for deterministic robot control, safety supervision, and low-level device management.
Reusable power-electronics components that regulate phase current and voltage for robot electric motors.
Analog and digital electronics that amplify, filter, isolate, convert, and synchronize robot sensor signals.
Deterministic wired communication subsystems linking robot controllers, drives, sensors, and safety devices.

Humanoid rotary-joint requirements, qualification, selection, packaging, and integration of eligible motor, transmission, sensing, braking, and bearing components; standalone mechanical components remain owned by core_mechanical_components.
Humanoid rotary-joint module integrating qualified motor, transmission, feedback, braking, and bearing components against joint packaging, load, lifetime, thermal, and control requirements.
Reusable frameless high-torque motor component for compact robot actuation, not duplicated by body location.

Humanoid rotary-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible strain-wave reducers, including ratio, backlash, rigidity, life, packaging, and thermal compatibility; standalone reducer products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid rotary-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible cycloidal reducers, including rigidity, load capacity, repeatability, life, packaging, and thermal compatibility; standalone reducer products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid rotary-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible precision planetary reducers, including backlash, ratio, torque density, life, packaging, and thermal compatibility; standalone reducer products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid rotary-joint feedback modules that package eligible position sensing, interfaces, calibration, and diagnostics for actuation assemblies; standalone encoder devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.
Reusable holding or emergency braking components that restrain robot joints when commanded or unpowered.

Humanoid joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible precision bearings under radial, axial, and moment loads, including stiffness, life, lubrication, packaging, and thermal compatibility; standalone bearing products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid linear-joint requirements, qualification, selection, packaging, and integration of eligible drive, screw, bearing, and displacement-sensing components; standalone mechanical components remain owned by core_mechanical_components.
Humanoid linear-joint module integrating qualified drive, transmission, support, and feedback components against packaging, load, stroke, lifetime, thermal, and control requirements.

Humanoid linear-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible planetary roller screws, including load, stroke, efficiency, life, lubrication, packaging, and thermal compatibility; standalone screw products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid linear-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible ball screws, including load, stroke, efficiency, backlash, life, lubrication, and packaging; standalone screw products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid linear-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible trapezoidal lead screws, including load, stroke, efficiency, wear, self-locking behavior, and packaging; standalone screw products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.
Reusable direct-drive motors that generate linear force without a rotary-to-linear screw transmission.

Humanoid linear-joint selection and qualification requirements for eligible screw-support bearing sets under combined axial and radial loads, including preload, stiffness, life, lubrication, and packaging; standalone bearing products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid linear-joint sensing requirements covering eligible displacement-sensor selection, packaging, calibration, interfaces, and integration for extension and position feedback; standalone sensor devices and fabrication remain owned by mems_intelligent_sensors.
Humanoid-specific arm and hand modules that integrate shared actuation, transmission, sensing, and control components.
Shoulder-specific kinematic module that integrates shared rotary joint assemblies into the humanoid upper limb.
Elbow-specific kinematic module that integrates shared rotary joint assemblies into the humanoid upper limb.
Wrist-specific kinematic module that integrates shared rotary joint assemblies into the humanoid upper limb.
Integrated humanoid upper-limb assembly combining shoulder, elbow, wrist, structure, cabling, sensing, and control interfaces.
Integrated multi-finger end-effector combining compact actuation, transmission, tactile-force sensing, and hand control interfaces.
Reusable compact actuators sized for dexterous finger joints and high-density hand packaging.

Humanoid dexterous-hand selection, qualification, packaging, and integration requirements for eligible miniature reducers used in compact finger mechanisms; standalone reducer products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.

Humanoid dexterous-hand routing, qualification, packaging, and integration requirements for eligible cable, tendon, and flexible transmissions; standalone precision transmission products and manufacturing remain owned by core_mechanical_components.
Integrated fingertip sensing and local control subsystem for contact detection, grip-force regulation, and slip response.
Humanoid-specific leg, foot, balance, and safety modules that integrate shared actuation and sensing components for biped mobility.
Hip-specific kinematic module that can integrate eligible rotary or linear joint assembly routes according to the humanoid architecture.
Knee-specific kinematic module that can integrate eligible rotary or linear joint assembly routes according to the humanoid architecture.
Ankle-specific kinematic module that can integrate eligible rotary or linear joint assembly routes according to the humanoid architecture.
Load-bearing lower-limb structure that locates hip, knee, ankle, cabling, covers, and interfaces for biped locomotion.
Compliant or energy-absorbing foot structures that moderate impact and improve ground contact during walking.
Integrated plantar sensing modules that measure ground reaction force, pressure distribution, and contact state.
Robot safety mechanisms that monitor stability margins and trigger protective posture, support, or shutdown responses.
Load-bearing structures, reusable structural parts, routing, covers, and environmental protection for the humanoid body.
Central humanoid structure that carries upper-body, lower-body, battery, compute, and payload loads.
System-level skeletal architecture optimized for stiffness, mass distribution, manufacturability, and service access.
Reusable lightweight metal structural components produced from aluminum or magnesium alloys for robot frames and housings.
Reusable composite structural components used where high specific stiffness and low mass justify added manufacturing complexity.
Reusable structural and interface parts produced by precision casting, forging, machining, or combined processes.
Integrated cable assemblies that distribute power, communications, sensor signals, grounding, and safety circuits through the robot.
External rigid or compliant covers that protect mechanisms and users while preserving joint motion and serviceability.
Seals, barriers, and enclosure features that protect robot systems from dust, moisture, debris, and accidental contact.
Robot-integrated energy storage, power conversion, charging, thermal control, budgeting, and emergency isolation systems.
Integrated rechargeable energy-storage packs configured for humanoid voltage, current, packaging, safety, and service requirements.

Humanoid-specific cell selection and integration requirements for runtime, mass, packaging, discharge, and safety; generic cell chemistry and manufacturing remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials.

nodes.node_name: Humanoid Battery Management Integration and Control
nodes.description: Humanoid-specific BMS integration, interfaces, limits, state estimation, and fault-control requirements; generic BMS products and technology remain owned by power_batteries_battery_materials.
Integrated conversion and distribution subsystem that supplies regulated robot power rails from the battery bus.
Robot-integrated docking, alignment, communication, and charging functions for unattended energy replenishment.
Cooling, heat spreading, sensing, and control for batteries, compute modules, drives, motors, and enclosed robot spaces.
Supervisory software that allocates limited electrical and thermal capacity across compute, actuation, sensing, and auxiliary loads.
Independent safety function that rapidly isolates hazardous robot power paths after faults or emergency commands.
Supplementary lifecycle and value-chain coverage for complete humanoid products, manufacturing, calibration, testing, operations, and scenario integration under the approved mixed-template rule.
Integrated humanoid robot products combining embodied software, controls, sensing, actuation, body modules, energy systems, and safety functions.
Manufacturing process for assembling, fastening, lubricating, wiring, programming, and tracing integrated robot joint modules.
System process that calibrates kinematics, sensors, actuators, timing, coordinate frames, and payload parameters on the complete robot.
Test process for joint accuracy, repeatability, speed, torque, gait, balance, manipulation, and dynamic response.
Qualification process covering endurance, duty cycles, environmental exposure, wear, fault recurrence, and maintainability.
Verification process for limits, collision response, emergency functions, electrical safety, stability, and human-contact risks.
Operational capability for fleet monitoring, diagnostics, software deployment, tele-assistance, incident handling, and service support.
Engineering service that adapts humanoid robots to industrial tasks, tools, workcells, safety systems, and production workflows.
Engineering service that adapts humanoid robots to commercial, public, household, or care workflows and operating constraints.
